game_title: Type Cast Forge – Lava River Crossing Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about forge_heat to power up the volcanologist and open the forge anvil.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
